description: Close a position (reduce-only, at market), or every one with all: true. Without confirm, returns what would close and a quote_id, and signs nothing. Closing is always allowed by the policy.

confirm.description: The user's agreement to this order. Without it nothing is signed.

max_slippage_bps.description: The worst price accepted, in basis points (default 300)

quote_id.description: The quote_id of the quote this confirms, as the same call without confirm returned it.

size.description: Part of the position, in the base asset, never more than it holds (the whole position when absent)

name: perps_close
title: Close positions
